name: write-studio
description: Ravi Kumar's portfolio studio: Next.js frontend, Express API, Django auth, Supabase database.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @studio/express-api && npm run build -w @studio/frontend
scripts.test: node --import tsx --test packages/shared/test/*.test.ts && cd frontend && node --import tsx --test test/schema.test.ts test/zip.test.ts
scripts.test:frontend: npm run typecheck -w @studio/frontend && npm run lint -w @studio/frontend && cd frontend && node --import tsx --test test/schema.test.ts test/zip.test.ts
scripts.test:backend: npm run typecheck -w @studio/express-api && npm run build -w @studio/express-api && npm run test:shared
scripts.test:shared: npm run typecheck -w @studio/shared && node --import tsx --test packages/shared/test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:django: cd backend/django && python manage.py check && python manage.py test accounts
